lines: At exactly midnight, every country on Earth receives the same order.
And by the end of this video, only one of them will still exist.
Hour one. The tiny countries go first.
Sorry, Monaco. It is nothing personal.
Sorry, San Marino. You were literally inside Italy.
In just one hour, thirty-four countries disappear from the map.
And the big ones... have not even started.
Europe. A continent that has done this before.
Okay. But this time, we do it efficiently.
Germany rolls through the Netherlands, Austria and Denmark before breakfast.
Sorry Switzerland. Neutral is not an option tonight.
Switzerland, Belgium, Luxembourg. Welcome to France.
Can we at least keep the banks?
For once, we are the ones expanding!
Poland sweeps through Slovakia, Hungary and all three Baltic states.
Italy crosses the Adriatic and takes the entire Balkans, all the way down to Greece.
And we invented pizza. Sit down.
We shall take Ireland, Iceland and Norway, thank you very much.
We were literally just having dinner.
And in the east... the biggest country on Earth wakes up.
So Ukraine grabs Belarus, Moldova, Romania and Bulgaria instead.
Forty-two European countries... become eight. In a single night.
Canada, buddy. You are with us now.
Canada falls without a single shot fired. Then Cuba, Haiti and the Dominican Republic.
If the gringos take the north, we take the south!
Mexico marches into Guatemala, Belize, El Salvador and Honduras.
Venezuela, Ecuador, Panama. You are all Colombian now.
Brazil is big. But Brazil wants to be bigger.
Brazil swallows Peru, Bolivia, Paraguay and the Guianas.
Chile, Uruguay. You are with me.
There is literally a mountain range between us!
Thirty-five countries in the Americas. Now just five empires are left.
Africa turns into the most chaotic battlefield on the planet.
Nigeria has the people. Nigeria has the energy!
Nigeria explodes across West Africa. Sixteen countries, in one night.
Everything south of the Congo belongs to South Africa.
Kenya, Somalia, Tanzania. Ethiopia is coming for you.
We are runners! We can escape!
Morocco, Tunisia, Mali. Algeria is the king of the north!
Excuse me? The pharaohs would like a word.
Egypt takes Libya and Sudan, and stares straight at Algeria.
Mongolia. Kazakhstan. Vietnam. Thailand. The waiting is over.
Not tonight, Vietnam. China pours into Central Asia and Southeast Asia at the same time.
Bangladesh, Nepal, Sri Lanka. India has arrived.
The Ottoman Empire is back, baby!
Turkey takes Syria, Iraq, Israel, Jordan and the entire Caucasus.
Qatar, Kuwait, the Emirates. We had the money. Now we have the land.
Korea is united... for the first time in seventy years.
Malaysia, Singapore, Papua. Indonesia rules the sea.
Mate. It is just us and New Zealand down here.
Do we get a say in this?
Japan will wait. Islands are very hard to invade.
Thirty countries left on Earth. And now... the empires start touching.
Six hours in. Quick look at the map. The biggest empires right now: Russia, China and the United States.
But size is not everything tonight.
When two empires share a border, only one survives.
Ukraine. I told you to stay over there.
Ukraine fights for hours. But Russia is just too big. Then Poland falls too.
Germany versus France. Everyone thinks they know how this one ends.
France keeps going. Italy falls. Then Spain.
Mexico, Colombia. The whole north is ours.
Argentina, this is not a football match.
In Africa, Egypt crushes Algeria and Ethiopia. Nigeria takes South Africa and the Congo.
Nigeria. Just you and me now.
Turkey swallows Iran and Saudi Arabia.
China takes Korea. India takes Pakistan.
Eleven empires left. And from here... it gets fast.
Russia turns west, straight into France.
Oh. Look at the time. Must dash.
France falls. And Britain learns that islands are not that safe after all.
Islands are very hard to invade!
Nigeria crosses the Suez Canal and takes the whole Middle East.
India marches through Southeast Asia, all the way to Australia.
Russia meets Nigeria across the Mediterranean.
Final four. The United States. Russia. China. India.
Hey Russia. We are neighbors too, you know.
But Russia has a bigger problem. To the south.
Russia and China. The two giants share the longest border in Asia.
Comrade. Let us talk about this.
China pushes north, all the way to the Arctic.
China and India. The two most populated countries on Earth.
We have been waiting for this.
It is the biggest battle in history. And India... pulls off the upset of the century.
India now controls Europe, Africa, Asia and Oceania. The United States holds the Americas.
The final battle. The strongest army on Earth, against the biggest population on Earth.
We have the best army in the world.
We have one point four billion people.
India lands in Canada. Then in Brazil. The Americas are attacked from both sides.
South America falls. Then Mexico. Then the Caribbean.
The last stand happens in Washington. It takes the whole night. But at sunrise... only one flag is left.
Would your country have done better? Tell us in the comments.
endq: WOULD YOUR COUNTRY HAVE DONE BETTER?
